# u-boot override for blitsCRT_Mister
#
# GENERATED by tools/gen_uboot_txt.py -- do not edit.
# Regenerate with: make uboot-txt
#
# MiSTer reads this when blitscrt.rbf is selected from the menu, writes it
# to DDR3 with a magic header, drops the HPS-to-FPGA bridges and warm
# reboots. u-boot then runs these commands instead of its own.
#
# The load is attempted 4 ways because MiSTer's u-boot is a fork with
# exFAT support and the partition layout varies. A serial console and
# 'printenv' names whichever one is real.

bootdelay=2

# Set explicitly. If this u-boot defines no loadaddr, ${loadaddr}
# expands to nothing and every load below fails for the wrong reason.
# Clear of the env block MiSTer leaves at 0x1FFFF000.
loadaddr=0x2000000

loadrbf=load mmc 0:1 ${loadaddr} blitscrt.rbf || fatload mmc 0:1 ${loadaddr} blitscrt.rbf || load mmc 0:2 ${loadaddr} blitscrt.rbf || fatload mmc 0:2 ${loadaddr} blitscrt.rbf

kernaddr=0x1000000
dtbaddr=0x3000000
loadkern=load mmc 0:1 ${kernaddr} blitscrt/zImage || fatload mmc 0:1 ${kernaddr} blitscrt/zImage || load mmc 0:2 ${kernaddr} blitscrt/zImage || fatload mmc 0:2 ${kernaddr} blitscrt/zImage
loaddtb=load mmc 0:1 ${dtbaddr} blitscrt/blitscrt.dtb || fatload mmc 0:1 ${dtbaddr} blitscrt/blitscrt.dtb || load mmc 0:2 ${dtbaddr} blitscrt/blitscrt.dtb || fatload mmc 0:2 ${dtbaddr} blitscrt/blitscrt.dtb
bootargs=console=ttyS0,115200

# Bridges left down. The kernel-boot proof touches no fabric
# registers, so there is nothing behind the bridges to reach
# yet -- one fewer variable. Turn on later with --bridges.
bootcmd=run loadrbf; fpga load 0 ${loadaddr} ${filesize}; run loadkern; run loaddtb; bootz ${kernaddr} - ${dtbaddr}
